commits.message:
docs: Powerline and capsule glyphs draw as shapes in example output (rich-docs-examples-xuu.b35)

The docs load a 40-glyph Powerline subset of Nerd Fonts Symbols, first in the
code font stack behind a unicode-range, fitted to Menlo's cell so a cap covers
its segment's background. scripts/powerline-font.py builds it.

docs: live and prompt pages run live, and NOT_YET_MIGRATED is gone (rich-docs-examples-xuu.byg) (#181)

* docs: live and prompt pages run live, and NOT_YET_MIGRATED is gone (rich-docs-examples-xuu.byg)

The last two pages migrate: every live.md example is a bounded live demo, and
every prompt.md prompt runs live, answered by what the reader types. For that,
bundleExample resolves node:readline to docs/.vitepress/node-readline.ts, a
createInterface/question over the simulated terminal, so nodeAsk runs
unchanged in the browser.

With no page left to migrate, NOT_YET_MIGRATED is deleted along with its gate
branch and tests. live.md's "Redirecting stdout/stderr" section is removed:
LiveOptions has no such options.

Filed from the live output: rich-prompt-vo5e, rich-live-sadk.

* fix(docs): the readline stand-in ignores escape sequences, keeps keys past an Enter, joins a split CRLF and streams UTF-8; lint checks it (rich-docs-examples-xuu.byg)

* fix(docs): a lone Esc in the readline stand-in no longer swallows the next key (rich-docs-examples-xuu.byg)
